test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 15 May, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**A sentence has been given with a blank to be filled with an appropriate option. Choose the correct alternative.**

I bowed to him, but he ______ not to see me.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Seemed**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence is in the past tense, so the correct verb form to use should be in the past tense.
 
• "**Seemed**" is the past tense form of "**seem**".
 
• The phrase "**he seemed not to see me**" means that he appeared to not notice or acknowledge the speaker.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4**.

**Complete sentence:** *I bowed to him, but he seemed __not to see me.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• '**Seems**' is in the present tense, which does not match the tense of the sentence.
 
• '**Seeming**' is a present participle form and does not work as the main verb in the sentence.
 
• '**Seemingly**' is an adverb and does not work as the main verb in the sentence.
